panels.title: Auto-fixed · 7 days

panels.title: Median time to diagnosis · 7 days
panels.description: Failure detected → fix proposed or escalated. Median of tickets opened in the last 7 days (the slow tail does not hide the typical case).

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH t AS (
  SELECT (julianday(e.at) - julianday(i.opened_at)) * 86400 AS s
  FROM incidents i JOIN (SELECT incident_id, min(at) AS at FROM incident_events WHERE kind IN ('status:awaiting_approval', 'status:escalated') GROUP BY incident_id) e
    USING (incident_id)
  WHERE i.opened_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-7 days') AND ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}'))
SELECT s AS "value" FROM t ORDER BY s LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT count(*) / 2 FROM t)

panels.title: Waiting for your decision
panels.description: Only tickets with a guardrail-checked fix waiting for a person, oldest first. Confidence is evidence-calibrated (0.4 × model + 0.6 × evidence checks): red < 0.70 escalates, amber needs approval, green ≥ 0.85 may auto-fix a known fix. Evidence, in order: the cause names what changed · a live check confirms it · the error's own document was found · knowledge search was strong (· = not recorded for older tickets). Approve / Deny open the console's confirm page.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT incident_id, max(id) AS id FROM diagnoses GROUP BY incident_id)
SELECT
  i.incident_id AS "Ticket",
  coalesce(i.pipeline, '?') AS "Pipeline",
  coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class'), '-') AS "Class",
  json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.cause') AS "Cause",
  'rerun ' || json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.resolution.action.parameters') AS "Proposed fix",
  coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) AS "Confidence",
  CASE WHEN coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) >= 0.85 THEN 'auto-fix eligible' WHEN coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) >= 0.7 THEN 'needs approval'
       WHEN coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) IS NULL THEN '-' ELSE 'escalate' END AS "Band",
  CASE json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.explained_by_change') WHEN 1 THEN '✓' WHEN 0 THEN '✗' ELSE '·' END || CASE json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.confirmed_by_check') WHEN 1 THEN '✓' WHEN 0 THEN '✗' ELSE '·' END || CASE json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.exact_error_doc') WHEN 1 THEN '✓' WHEN 0 THEN '✗' ELSE '·' END || CASE json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.signals.knowledge_ok') WHEN 1 THEN '✓' WHEN 0 THEN '✗' ELSE '·' END AS "Evidence",
  CASE WHEN json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.auto_approval.memory_id') IS NULL THEN 'none on record'
       ELSE 'worked ' || json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.auto_approval.successes') || '×, failed '
            || json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.auto_approval.failures') || '×' END AS "Known fix",
  round((julianday('now') - julianday(i.updated_at)) * 1440) AS "Waiting (min)",
  'Approve' AS "Approve",
  'Deny' AS "Deny"
FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN latest l USING (incident_id) LEFT JOIN diagnoses d ON d.id = l.id
WHERE i.status = 'awaiting_approval' AND json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.resolution.action') IS NOT NULL AND ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}')
ORDER BY i.updated_at

panels.title: Handed to a person
panels.description: Tickets the copilot could not fix safely on its own. Act outside the copilot (the suggested step is a start), then Close: it opens a confirm page, nothing runs, and your note goes into the history.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT incident_id, max(id) AS id FROM diagnoses GROUP BY incident_id)
SELECT
  i.incident_id AS "Ticket",
  coalesce(i.pipeline, '?') AS "Pipeline",
  coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class'), '-') AS "Class",
  coalesce((SELECT e.detail FROM incident_events e WHERE e.incident_id = i.incident_id AND e.kind = 'status:escalated'
            ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 1), '-') AS "Why the copilot stopped",
  coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.resolution.steps[0]'), 'see the ticket') AS "Suggested next step",
  round((julianday('now') - julianday(i.updated_at)) * 24, 1) AS "Open for (h)",
  'Close' AS "Close"
FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN latest l USING (incident_id) LEFT JOIN diagnoses d ON d.id = l.id
WHERE i.status = 'escalated' AND ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}')
ORDER BY i.updated_at

panels.title: Where tickets are, and how they ended · last 30 days
Lifecycle
panels.description: Left to right: detected → diagnosed → waiting → fixing → how it ended. Ends are split so you can see how much the copilot fixes on its own.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  count(*) AS "Detected",
  sum(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM diagnoses x WHERE x.incident_id = i.incident_id)) AS "Diagnosed",
  sum(status = 'awaiting_approval') AS "Awaiting approval",
  sum(status IN ('open', 'investigating', 'remediating')) AS "In progress",
  sum(status = 'resolved' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incident_events a WHERE a.incident_id = i.incident_id AND a.kind = 'auto_approved')) AS "Fixed, approved by a person",
  sum(status = 'resolved' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM incident_events a WHERE a.incident_id = i.incident_id AND a.kind = 'auto_approved')) AS "Auto-fixed",
  sum(status = 'escalated') AS "Escalated",
  sum(status IN ('rejected', 'closed')) AS "Closed, nothing run"
FROM incidents i WHERE i.opened_at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-30 days') AND ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}')

panels.title: Fixes that worked, by confidence
panels.description: Of the fixes that were run (approved or auto-applied), the share whose rerun was verified, per confidence band. A trustworthy score has higher bands working more often; small counts mean a trend to watch, not proof.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT incident_id, max(id) AS id FROM diagnoses GROUP BY incident_id), b AS (
  SELECT i.incident_id, coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) AS c
  FROM incidents i JOIN latest l USING (incident_id) JOIN diagnoses d ON d.id = l.id WHERE ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}')), o AS (
  SELECT incident_id, max(kind IN ('approval:approve', 'auto_approved')) AS tried, max(kind = 'status:resolved') AS ok
  FROM incident_events GROUP BY incident_id)
SELECT CASE WHEN c >= 0.85 THEN '≥ 0.85' WHEN c >= 0.7 THEN '0.70 – 0.85' ELSE '< 0.70' END
         || ' · ' || sum(o.ok AND o.tried) || ' of ' || sum(o.tried) || ' fixes' AS name,
       1.0 * sum(o.ok AND o.tried) / sum(o.tried) AS value
FROM b JOIN o USING (incident_id) WHERE c IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c >= 0.85, c >= 0.7 HAVING sum(o.tried) > 0 ORDER BY min(c) DESC

  FROM incidents i JOIN latest l USING (incident_id) JOIN diagnoses d ON d.id = l.id WHERE ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}')), o AS (

GROUP BY c >= 0.85, c >= 0.7 HAVING sum(o.tried) > 0 ORDER BY min(c) DESC

panels.title: Diagnoses by confidence band
panels.description: Every ticket's latest diagnosis by evidence-calibrated confidence. Calibrated = 0.4 × the model's number + 0.6 × the share of the four evidence checks that passed.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT incident_id, max(id) AS id FROM diagnoses GROUP BY incident_id), b AS (
  SELECT i.incident_id, coalesce(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.confidence.calibrated'), json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.confidence')) AS c
  FROM incidents i JOIN latest l USING (incident_id) JOIN diagnoses d ON d.id = l.id WHERE ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}'))
SELECT CASE WHEN c >= 0.85 THEN '≥ 0.85 · auto-fix eligible' WHEN c >= 0.7 THEN '0.70 – 0.85 · needs approval'
            ELSE '< 0.70 · escalated' END AS name, count(*) AS value
FROM b WHERE c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c >= 0.85, c >= 0.7 ORDER BY min(c) DESC

panels.title: Why a known fix did or did not auto-apply · 30 days
panels.description: Every auto-apply decision: applied, or the rule that held it back for a person.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN e.kind = 'auto_approved' THEN 'auto-fixed'
            ELSE 'held: ' || replace(substr(e.detail, 1, CASE WHEN instr(e.detail, ' (') > 0 THEN instr(e.detail, ' (') - 1 ELSE length(e.detail) END),
                                     'needs a person: ', '') END AS "Decision",
       count(*) AS "Tickets"
FROM incident_events e JOIN incidents i USING (incident_id)
WHERE e.kind IN ('auto_approved', 'auto_approval:no') AND e.at >= strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S', 'now', '-30 days') AND ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Learned fixes
panels.description: Everything the copilot has learned: the failure pattern, the fix that worked, its track record and whether it may apply itself. A fix that fails later is distrusted and no longer offered.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT
  m.id AS "#",
  m.failure_class AS "Class",
  coalesce(m.pipeline_key, '-') AS "Pipeline",
  m.failed_task AS "Failed task",
  coalesce(nullif(substr(m.pattern, length(rtrim(m.pattern, replace(m.pattern, '|', ''))) + 1), '-'), '-') AS "What changed",
  'rerun ' || coalesce(m.fix_json, '?') AS "Fix that worked",
  m.fix_successes AS "Worked",
  m.failure_count AS "Failed",
  CASE WHEN m.failure_count > 0 THEN 'distrusted'
       WHEN m.fix_successes >= 2 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connections c WHERE m.pipeline_key LIKE c.connection_id || ':%' AND c.auto_apply = 1)
         THEN 'auto-fix on'
       WHEN m.fix_successes >= 2 THEN 'eligible, switched off'
       ELSE 'needs ' || (2 - m.fix_successes) || ' more' END AS "Auto-fix",
  (SELECT group_concat(value, ', ') FROM json_each(m.incident_ids)) AS "Learned from",
  replace(substr(m.updated_at, 1, 16), 'T', ' ') AS "Last used (UTC)"
FROM memories m ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC

  (SELECT group_concat(value, ', ') FROM json_each(m.incident_ids)) AS "Learned from",
  replace(substr(m.updated_at, 1, 16), 'T', ' ') AS "Last used (UTC)"
FROM memories m ORDER BY m.updated_at DESC

panels.title: Tickets per day, by failure class
panels.description: Opened tickets per day, stacked by the diagnosed failure class.

targets.rawQueryText:
WITH latest AS (SELECT incident_id, max(id) AS id FROM diagnoses GROUP BY incident_id)
SELECT substr(i.opened_at, 1, 10) AS "Day",
  sum(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class') = 'permissions') AS "permissions",
  sum(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class') = 'data_quality') AS "data quality",
  sum(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class') = 'resource_exhaustion') AS "out of memory",
  sum(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class') = 'missing_input') AS "missing input",
  sum(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class') = 'schema_change') AS "schema change",
  sum(json_extract(d.diagnosis_json, '$.root_cause.failure_class') IS NULL) AS "not diagnosed"
FROM incidents i LEFT JOIN latest l USING (incident_id) LEFT JOIN diagnoses d ON d.id = l.id
WHERE ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Latest activity (audit trail)
panels.description: Every step the copilot and people took, newest first.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT replace(substr(e.at, 1, 19), 'T', ' ') AS "Time (UTC)", e.incident_id AS "Ticket", e.kind AS "Step",
  e.detail AS "Detail"
FROM incident_events e JOIN incidents i USING (incident_id) WHERE ('${platform}' = '__all' OR i.platform = '${platform}') AND ('${app}' = '__all' OR i.pipeline = '${app}') ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT 40
